decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (ST_SEPTEMBER_3_GLE 00 - Received: 10 January 2018
Flood Risk Assessment - Received: 12 January 2018
ST_SEPTEMBER_3 GLE 01 Rev F, ST_SEPTEMBER_3 GLE 02 Rev F - Received: 07 March 2018) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of a single storey side and rear extension to the house
